verdict.rationale: Bruno is local-first by design: collections are stored on the user's filesystem, there is no mandatory cloud account or sync, and official Docker images let the CLI be run entirely within a user's own infrastructure/CI pipeline. This satisfies the self-hosting story since the core product never depends on a vendor-hosted service. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a self-hosted team/sync server option (only 'no cloud sync' is stated) and independent verification of running the Docker-based CLI in production self-hosted setups.
